item.title: Amazon Toy Compliance Checklist Before You Launch an ASIN
item.description: A stage-by-stage checklist for launching a toy on Amazon: CPC and tracking label in the US, CE plus GPSR fields in the EU, warning wording, restricted categories, battery documents, and the file set that clears a compliance review.

item.title: EU GPSR for Toy Sellers: The 2024 Rules in Practice
item.description: GPSR has applied since 13 December 2024. What it actually requires from toy sellers — an EU responsible person, listing disclosures, technical files — and where CE plus EN71 is no longer enough.

item.title: CPC Certificate for Amazon Toy Sellers: What Actually Gets Rejected
item.description: What a Children's Product Certificate must contain to clear Amazon and US customs, why most toy CPCs get rejected, and how to get one from a Chinese factory.
